decision.explanation: Two distinct documents provide conflicting but valid claims about which sports team Sergio González Soriano represents. Document d1 states he currently plays for Guizhou Renhe F.C. in China, while document d2 describes his long-standing association with RCD Espanyol de Barcelona, including his role as captain. Both are direct assertions from their respective sources and refer to different timeframes or roles. Neither source explicitly contradicts the other’s validity, so both are retained as complementary answers.
